topics.title: Bundesweiter Warntag
topics.englishContext: Germany tests its public warning systems once a year. Test messages can arrive through Cell Broadcast, warning apps, radio, television and, in some places, sirens. It is only a test, but it helps people understand what an official warning may look and sound like.

interestingFacts.de: Die Probewarnung wird um 11 Uhr verschickt. Gegen 11:45 Uhr folgt die Entwarnung.
interestingFacts.en: The test warning is sent at 11:00 am. The all-clear follows at around 11:45 am.

guides.title: Informationen zum Bundesweiten Warntag
guides.summary: Official information from Germany’s Federal Office of Civil Protection and Disaster Assistance.

topics.title: Tag des offenen Denkmals
topics.englishContext: On this Sunday, historic buildings and special places across Germany open to the public. You can often join a guided tour, visit an exhibition or discover a place in your own area that is normally closed.

interestingFacts.en: The 2026 theme is: “Networks: monuments and infrastructure.”

guides.title: Programm zum Tag des offenen Denkmals
guides.summary: Find participating places and events in your region.

topics.title: Pilze sammeln im Herbst
topics.englishContext: In September, many people enjoy walks in the forest and notice more mushrooms. Some collect edible mushrooms, but it is important to take only mushrooms that you can identify with complete certainty.

interestingFacts.de: Pilze können sich sehr ähnlich sehen. Nimm nur Pilze mit, die du sicher kennst.
interestingFacts.en: Mushrooms can look very similar. Only take mushrooms that you know with certainty.

topics.title: Der Herbst kommt näher
topics.englishContext: September often brings cooler mornings and evenings, even when afternoons are still sunny. A light jacket becomes useful again, while people still enjoy the last warm days outside.

interestingFacts.de: Für Meteorologen beginnt der Herbst am 1. September. Astronomisch beginnt er erst am 22. oder 23. September.
interestingFacts.en: For meteorologists, autumn begins on 1 September. Astronomically, it begins only on 22 or 23 September.
